meta.description: Registry for Phase 2 formal stability failure modes.

failure_modes.name: boundary_instability
failure_modes.description: Erratic participation classification near null threshold.

failure_modes.name: window_collapse
failure_modes.description: Admissibility window collapses to null set under perturbation.

failure_modes.name: residue_divergence
failure_modes.description: Residue-update leads to unbounded or non-physical state expansion.

failure_modes.name: coupling_dissociation
failure_modes.description: Loss of residue-mediated binding between participation and continuation.

failure_modes.name: class_drift
failure_modes.description: Formal objects drift outside their declared classes under iteration.
